comments.typescript: Held on the 5.x line: typescript-eslint 8.x declares a peer range of >=4.8.4 <6.1.0, so TypeScript 6/7 cannot be type-check-linted yet. Revisit when typescript-eslint widens the range.
comments.engines: Mirrors the nodejs pin in pixi.toml, which is the source of truth. Keep the two in step; npm treats this field as advisory unless engine-strict is set.
